bug_semantics: A caller with host-volume-create and node-read access can supply both a target NodeID and a traversal-bearing PluginID. The server's explicit-NodeID path returned the node without checking that the named plugin was fingerprinted there, forwarded PluginID unchanged to ClientHostVolume.Create, and the client joined that attacker-controlled identifier to the plugin directory and executed the resulting executable as the Nomad agent user, commonly root.
flaw_origin: The first reconstructable PR member, 566dfb2f399db4a2545f81ea9d283bcd4b6771cd, replaced the parent's pre-registered plugin map lookup with on-demand external-plugin resolution and introduced path := filepath.Join(hvm.pluginDir, id), where id comes from req.PluginID. That atomic member is the first write of the traversal mechanism; the later landed aggregate 46a39560bb996a8b6df2619b0c90717771225e05 and subsequent refactors preserved it.

evidence: HashiCorp HCSEC-2026-15 states that Nomad Community Edition 1.10.0 through 2.0.0 and Nomad Enterprise 1.10.0 through 2.0.0 are affected; fixed releases are Community 2.0.1 and Enterprise 2.0.1, 1.11.5, and 1.10.11: https://discuss.hashicorp.com/t/hcsec-2026-15-nomad-vulnerable-to-path-traversal-in-dynamic-host-volume-which-may-lead-to-code-execution/77417

The CVE.org record for CVE-2026-7474 is PUBLISHED with HashiCorp as CNA and describes client-host code execution through dynamic-host-volume path traversal; it is not rejected or withdrawn: https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-7474

At fix parent 62bf44e1b1d2ccb9bf10c1338d803512f9dbd1d2, nomad/host_volume_endpoint.go:183-245 checks host-volume-create ACL and calls placeHostVolume; lines 523-533 return immediately for an explicit NodeID, bypassing the plugin is_set constraint built at lines 555-566; lines 466-480 forward vol.PluginID unchanged to ClientHostVolume.Create.

At 62bf44e1b1d2ccb9bf10c1338d803512f9dbd1d2, client/host_volume_endpoint.go:25-34 passes the request to hostVolumeManager.Create, and client/hostvolumemanager/host_volume_plugin.go:229-230 computes filepath.Join(pluginDir, filename) and os.Stat(executable), allowing a traversal-bearing filename to escape the intended directory before execution.

GitHub PR #24589 reports five reconstructable commits; the clone contains the complete linear member chain 566dfb2f399db4a2545f81ea9d283bcd4b6771cd -> 06f577acd65c4e47294c93d0be17440df8060048 -> e2211f676b8e1a4e332d4127c1fb722da588f57a -> 5b573db000c0010dcb0d36f8c160867e34ded785 -> 8fb154768d99f7344c83bf829c62adcc09502b4d: https://api.github.com/repos/hashicorp/nomad/pulls/24589/commits

reasoning: The vendor and CVE records establish a real, published vulnerability: an authorized host-volume creator can target a known node and use a traversal PluginID to make the client execute an executable outside the administrator-controlled plugin directory as the Nomad agent. Source inspection closes the route from HostVolume.Create through the explicit-NodeID placement bypass and ClientHostVolume.Create to the unsafe client path construction. PR #24589 was decomposed instead of treating its aggregate as atomic: its first member 566dfb2f399db4a2545f81ea9d283bcd4b6771cd first replaced safe pre-registration with attacker-influenced path construction, while direct parent 12285858a8a0612a419b65b65aa8baa818e3034b lacks that mechanism. The member's code survives in the landed 46a39560bb996a8b6df2619b0c90717771225e05 lineage before the affected 1.10.0 boundary. Direct fix cd7240c4099ad33eda279924fb3a9459b162d120 confines lookup with os.Root and removes the explicit-node plugin-check bypass, and release ancestry places it in v2.0.1 but not v2.0.0. Because the atomic BIC commit object has only human author/committer identities and no AI marker, the correct BIC-only verdict is NOT_AI; AI assistance in discovering/reporting the vulnerability in 2026 cannot retroactively attribute the 2024 BIC.
